postings.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
postings.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.
You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.


What You'll Do
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

• Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

• Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

• Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

Who You Are
• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies.

• You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

• You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

• You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

• You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

• You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York City

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $87,069-$124,385 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

postings.title: Accounting Analyst, Content Accounting
postings.description:
Our Global Content Accounting Operations team makes sure the songwriters behind the music on Spotify are accurately accounted for and paid, everywhere in the world. Reporting to the Manager of Content Accounting, you’ll support songwriter royalty accounting globally and partner closely with Legal, Licensing, Technical Accounting, and Engineering. You’ll also help shape what comes next: rolling out claiming processes in new territories as Spotify expands, finding new ways to show the accounting impact of business decisions, steering updates to our claiming systems, and streamlining month-end close in a fast-growing region.

What You'll do
- Execute the monthly global content accounting close, delivering accurate results on time for reporting, including account reconciliations, roll-forward analyses, and insight-driven flux commentary.

- Review licensor claim files and invoices promptly and accurately, meeting all contractual deadlines and flagging discrepancies for resolution.

- Review and interpret legal agreements to ensure royalty payments are calculated and disbursed correctly, and give clear, timely feedback to internal and external stakeholders on royalty calculations and invoice reviews.

- Develop and refine content accounting processes and procedures, and support internal, external, and third-party audit and SOX requirements for your areas of responsibility.

- Partner with Technical Accounting, Finance, Legal, Content, Sales, Sales Operations, FP&A, Billing, AR, IT, Tax, and business owners on policies, processes, and programs, helping drive key system initiatives and improvements.

- Mentor, teach, and review the work of supporting members of the global accounting team, and help our offshore team with questions on invoicing and claims.

- Take part in special projects such as ERP implementation, system enhancements, third-party audits, and ad hoc analyses.

- Travel occasionally and be available for late nights, weekends, or holidays when the close or business needs require it.

Who You Are
- You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, ideally with a CPA or CA, and have 3+ years of professional experience, with Big 4 or entertainment and media experience a plus.

- You have exceptional time management and organizational skills, with a track record of prioritizing multiple concurrent responsibilities and consistently meeting deadlines.

- You take a proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous process improvement.

- You’re curious about AI tools and have hands-on experience using them to drive process improvements, automations, and efficiencies.

- You have advanced Excel skills, experience with ERP systems such as NetSuite, Oracle, or SAP, and proficiency in SQL and BigQuery.

- You thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment, and experience with IFRS and/or SOX is an advantage.

- You communicate clearly and know how to escalate potential issues to the right team early to prevent process delays.

Where You'll Be
This role is based in New York.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

postings.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
postings.description:
Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

What You'll Do
- Build a deep understanding of Spotify’s label, publishing, lyrics, and audiobook contracts, how they’re implemented in our royalty systems, and how they flow into royalty calculations, downstream datasets, and reporting.

- Use the team’s internal AI tooling to configure contracts in Spotify’s royalty systems and test financial outputs for accuracy before sign-off from Commercial Accounting.

- Lead data analyses to answer royalty questions from internal teams such as Legal & Licensing and Finance, and from external partners such as rightsholders and back offices.

- Support month-end royalty close by reviewing checks, validating calculation outputs, and escalating risks or issues.

- Run month-end analytics, from generating the data and deck to providing commentary on fluxes, to support Content Accounting’s sign-off on final royalty figures.

- Help build new capabilities for the team, contributing directly to how our internal AI tooling evolves as Spotify’s business grows.

- Partner closely with Legal & Licensing, Commercial Accounting, Content Accounting, and Financial Engineering.

Who You Are
- You have a background in Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.

- You have 1+ years of experience in a data analyst or technical operations role. Experience in a royalty-related role at a record label, digital service provider, or music publisher is a plus.

- You have strong technical and data analysis skills, such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, or Google Cloud Platform.

- You bring an AI-first approach to problem-solving and are excited to get hands-on building and evolving internal tooling.

- You’re curious about royalties and the music industry, and how Spotify pays the people who create content on our platform. Familiarity with label, publisher, or audiobook contracts, or with DSP data files, is a bonus.

- You’re organized and flexible, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

- You’re a coachable self-starter who enjoys learning new concepts and coordinating across teams to meet deadlines.

- You’re detail-oriented with a high bar for accuracy, because our numbers drive real payouts to rightsholders.

Where You'll Be
This role is based in Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

postings.description:

As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization.
In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. 
We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment.

- Act as a representative of Spotify externally in the music industry and empower artists and labels with knowledge, insights, and tools they need to succeed on Spotify, acting as their advocate and champion.

- IRL events and music marketing: Proactively identify and pursue new growth opportunities in areas such as superfan engagement and live events together with cross-functional teams, work together to bring these initiatives to life.

- You have expertise in the electronic music space (preferred)

- You have a strong understanding of the digital music landscape and streaming platforms.

- You are an excellent project manager with a track record in leading projects from end to end, including marketing campaigns, live events and cultural activations

postings.title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
postings.description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

What You'll Do
- Lead a high-performing team focused on building a better future for artists, songwriters, and the music industry on Spotify.

- Set and execute against a policy agenda for the team based on the biggest needs for artists, songwriters, music partners, listeners, and Spotify.

- Own strategy and execution around Spotify’s music policy portfolio, including Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, Music Spam Filter, Preferred Provider Program, and more.

- Develop and implement new policies that equitably impact the music ecosystem on topics like royalty administration, artificial streaming, new music technologies, music platform rules, and more.

- Partner closely with technical and operational teams on content policy — including platform integrity issues, metadata strategy, and music supply chain dynamics.

- Work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to implement technical solutions for our policy agenda.

- Craft clear, informative messaging about existing and new policies — and launch scaled educational initiatives to make sure artists, songwriters, distributors, and rights holders have accurate information about our platform.

- Collaborate with Music Partnerships and Licensing to understand the needs of all the stakeholders on our music platform, to advocate for and explain new policies, and to listen to and incorporate feedback.

- Partner with Data Science and Music Economics to deeply understand platform trends and the potential impact of various policy decisions.

Who You Are
- You have 10+ years of relevant experience in the music industry, policy, legal, or technology platforms.

- You have proven experience in the music industry, working with artists and creators, and with technology platforms. You have a deep understanding of the music supply chain.

- You’re a dedicated people leader, caring deeply about the health and growth of the people on your team.

- You have a deep passion for technology, love getting into the weeds of technical solutions, and have experience working closely with engineering

- You have passion for creating a more rewarding, fairer experience for artists and songwriters around the world. You love music.

- You’re comfortable diving deep into spreadsheets, talking to technical teams, mapping out complex incentive systems, and sweating the details.

- You’re a strong communicator and a strong listener — understanding when to influence others and when to incorporate smart feedback.

- You’re experienced at bringing cross-functional teams together in a shared vision.

We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We're looking for a Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled Sales team, one of the fastest-growing teams within Spotify Advertising. In this role, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, serving as a trusted advisor who understands their business goals and delivers advertising solutions that drive measurable impact. You'll combine strategic thinking, commercial expertise, and relationship management to develop long-term partnerships while helping advertisers unlock the full value of Spotify's advertising platform.
 
If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

- Manage an active sales pipeline, maintain accurate forecasting, and effectively prioritize opportunities across multiple accounts.

- Partner closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales Planning, Client Services, Marketing, Product, Measurement, and Data—to deliver exceptional client experiences and maximize campaign success.

- Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Spotify Advertising by sharing market insights, client feedback, and best practices across the broader sales organization.

postings.description:

You’ll help bring Spotify’s music, podcast, and cultural moments to life through storytelling that Indonesian audiences want to follow, engage with, and share.

You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

postings.description:
Spotify's Emerging & Scaled (E&S) business is growing rapidly across the US and Canada, and we're investing in accelerating first-time advertiser growth. As part of our mission to help brands connect with fans through audio and video, we're expanding our New Business organization.

We're looking for an experienced Director of Sales to lead our New Business acquisition strategy across North America. In this role, you'll lead and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team, driving the full sales cycle from prospecting through closing. Reporting to E&S leadership, you'll shape scalable acquisition strategies, strengthen pipeline generation, and create a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching and measurable performance goals. You'll play a key role in unlocking new advertiser categories and driving sustainable net-new revenue growth.

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team responsible for the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification through negotiation and closing.

- Build scalable prospecting strategies, outreach frameworks, and repeatable sales processes that accelerate pipeline generation and first-time advertiser acquisition.

- Foster a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching, clear performance expectations, measurable KPIs, and disciplined pipeline management.

- Develop and implement sales playbooks, vertical-specific narratives, and performance storytelling that help sellers engage prospective advertisers and convert opportunities into revenue.

- Build relationships with agencies, brands, and senior decision-makers, identifying new opportunities and turning first-time advertisers into long-term partners.

- You have 10+ years of experience in digital media sales or related B2B industries, including 5+ years leading, coaching, and developing high-performing sales teams.

postings.title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
postings.description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/


What You'll Do
Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:

Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.

Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.

Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.

You will also:

- Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.

- Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.

- Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.

- Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.

- Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.

Who You Are
- You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.

- You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.

- You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.

- You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.

- You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.

- You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.

- You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.

- You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Where You'll Be
- We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

- This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

- Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.

The United States base range for this position is $133,194 - $190,278 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, a monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays. These ranges may be modified in the future.

postings.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.
You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.


What You'll Do
• Own sales operations for Spotify Technology, including CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, territory and account assignment, and deal desk processes.

• Design and roll out a segmented sales model that evolves our go-to-market approach as the business matures.

• Build infrastructure and systems to support a scalable Commercial sales motion (companies with fewer than 1,000 employees), focused on faster deal cycles, efficient lead routing, and repeatable processes.

• Build infrastructure and systems to support a strategic Enterprise sales motion (companies with 1,000+ employees), enabling prospecting, account planning, and multi-product engagements.

• Partner with the Director of Sales as a strategic advisor on quota setting, capacity planning, compensation, territory design, and headcount modeling.

• Support revenue across the full customer lifecycle, including new business, expansion, and retention.

• Build reporting and dashboards to track pipeline coverage, conversion rates, time to close, forecast accuracy, and net revenue retention by segment.

• Strengthen forecasting discipline and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline through effective reporting and sales processes.

• Identify friction across the sales process, including handoffs between Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and drive improvements with cross-functional partners.

• Partner with Marketing on pipeline generation reporting, lead management, and process improvements.

• Establish and continuously improve operating rhythms, including forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), as the business scales.

• Evaluate and manage the go-to-market (GTM) technology stack to support efficient and scalable sales operations.

Who You Are
• You have 6+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market strategy, with a track record of meaningful impact at a senior level.

• You have experience scaling sales operations through a startup or high-growth phase and understand when to introduce new processes and structure.

• You can build systems and processes from the ground up without adding unnecessary complexity.

• You are proficient in using AI and can lead initiatives that improve sales effectiveness through AI-enabled tools and processes.

• You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within developer platforms, DevOps tools, or cloud services.

• You understand the differences between product-led growth (PLG), Commercial, and Enterprise sales motions and have experience designing segmented sales models.

• You understand complex technical sales involving Sales Engineering and recognize the importance of customer retention and post-sale success in revenue strategy.

• You have hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, including building reports, workflows, and resolving data issues.

• You use data to guide forecasting, capacity modeling, and funnel analysis, combining analytical skills with sound business judgment.

• You can influence senior sales leaders, build alignment across teams, and drive decisions without formal authority.

• You are comfortable working in evolving environments, adapting as priorities change, and helping shape how an innovative business grows.

Where You'll Be

postings.title: Senior Applied Research Scientist - Personalization
postings.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Within Personalization, the Speak Team owns the development of Spotify's state-of-the-art speech models, contributing to speech recognition, speech synthesis, and speech-to-speech models. We craft voice models that match human-level emotional expressiveness, so we can deeply engage our listeners and support creators at scale. Our groundbreaking work on speech synthesis relies on state-of-the-art deep learning methods and evaluation techniques, highly efficient data processing and model serving, and capturing audio of outstanding quality from our voice talent pool.

We're looking for a senior applied research scientist with experience in developing novel ML techniques and architectures and with a strong interest in working across a full production pipeline to produce state-of-the-art generative conversational speech-to-speech models. You'll collaborate with our engineering teams to help develop our production pipelines, explore new ideas and methods to improve quality, understanding and realism, as well as push the frontiers of what is possible with our speech technology.


What You'll Do
- Develop and experiment with new methods for speech synthesis and speech recognition, along with end-to-end approaches, building on the latest research and ideas.

- Work towards the expansion of our speech use-cases targeting different markets and products.

- Be part of a highly motivated research team dedicated to building and creating models at scale to power the Spotify platform.

- Champion best practices for research and development, sharing your knowledge and experience with other researchers within Speak.

- Collaborate with our engineering and data teams on ideas requiring new infrastructure or new high-quality data, as well as to help improve our speech recognition and speech synthesis pipelines, and help turn proven ideas into scalable products.

Who You Are
- You have a strong background in ML (PhD degree on top of professional experience), and experience in working with any of the following: transformers, GANs, diffusion models, flow matching, VAEs, audio codecs.

- You have experience in developing generative models for speech synthesis, speech recognition, audio/music, natural language processing, or computer vision.

- You have strong experience with Python, particularly PyTorch.

- You have strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical ideas with clarity to technical and non-technical people alike.

- You have experience in an academic or professional setting conducting high-quality research.

- This role is based in New York City.

postings.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Content Platform
postings.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. postings.title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
postings.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/


What You'll Do
- Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engage with generative AI music.

- Design and run large-scale analyses and evaluations of generative music systems, from prompt interpretation to model output quality, using Spotify's unique behavioral datasets, annotations, and experimentation platforms.

- Partner with Engineers and AI Researchers to integrate evaluation signals into model development loops, debugging workflows, and product iteration, making sure scientific rigor informs technical direction.

- Identify the behavioral and market dynamics that shape sustainable consumer demand and creator participation, and translate them into clear strategic recommendations.

- Build practical, scalable metrics and decision systems that define what "good" looks like for AI music: credibility, user delight, safety, creator alignment, and ecosystem trust.

- Bring together model, user behavior, and ecosystem signals into clear narratives that shape product strategy, cross-functional alignment, and long-term priorities across Spotify.

- Create the datasets, dashboards, and long-term measurement systems that give Spotify a lasting, comprehensive understanding of product health and impact.

- Work closely with Product, Design, Research, Legal, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Policy, and Licensing teams, bringing statistical rigor and principled measurement to help build artist-first systems that scale responsibly.

Who You Are 
- You have a track record of using insights to shape strategy for major company initiatives involving many different partners.

- You have significant hands-on experience in advanced analytics or data science, ideally in a domain involving LLM evaluation, user-generated content, or complex user behavior.

- You communicate clearly, form well-founded, evidence-backed points of view, and can bring together messy, multimodal signals (quantitative, qualitative, and model telemetry) into clear narratives for senior executives, researchers, engineers, and the music industry.

- You're proficient in advanced analytics with Python and SQL, have analyzed large datasets, and use AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to increase your productivity and impact.

- You have experience developing metrics frameworks for complex products that help teams measure impact and reason clearly about priorities.

- You have experience with machine learning frameworks, designing and assessing multimodal or embedding-based models, and validating them against LLM judges or human ground truth, with an understanding of how to evaluate models beyond offline accuracy.

You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.


What You'll Do
- Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.

- Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.

- Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.

- Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.

- Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.

- Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.

- Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.

- Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.

- Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.

- Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.

- Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.

Who You Are
- You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.

- You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.

- You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.

- You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.

- You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.

postings.title: Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing
postings.description:
Spotify is shaping the future of advertising by connecting brands with fans through audio, video, and experiences that are part of people's everyday lives. As our advertising business grows, we're focused on bringing innovative products to market, helping advertisers succeed, and turning new ideas into meaningful business growth.
We're looking for a Senior Director, Global Advertising Product Marketing to lead the next chapter of our global Advertising Product Marketing team. Reporting to the Head of Advertising Business Marketing, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to shape product strategy, strengthen our market position, and help advertisers get more value from Spotify.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a product marketing function with a clear voice in product decisions and a direct impact on business growth. You'll bring customer insights into product development, establish a disciplined approach to go-to-market execution and product adoption, create compelling reasons for advertisers to choose Spotify, and help a global team deliver measurable results.


What You'll Do
- Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for global Advertising Product Marketing, connecting advertiser needs, product innovation, competitive insights, and business growth.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing leaders to bring customer and market insights into product decisions and turn innovation into solutions advertisers value.

- Lead global go-to-market strategies for Spotify's advertising products, including brand and performance advertising, self-service, programmatic, and emerging solutions. Own product positioning, messaging, packaging, launches, and adoption.

- Build a deeper understanding of advertisers, agencies, buying behaviors, and the competitive landscape. Use these insights to identify opportunities, influence product priorities, and strengthen Spotify's position in the market.

- Drive product adoption and commercial growth by identifying customer needs, addressing barriers to adoption, and partnering with teams to improve product usage, retention, and revenue. Define clear measures of success and use results to guide future decisions.
